scope: Repair Workspace dictation: iOS Safari capture and upload failures, and losses from quiet pieces, brief upload failures, token refresh, Stop and multi-channel microphones. Record the mixed-language root cause without changing transcription.

keep: Existing composer draft, manual Send, authenticated voice endpoint, account pinning and accounting
extend: Bounded audio start and interruption recovery
At most two automatic retries of passing upload failures
Flush the last audio on Stop
replace: Replace AbortSignal.any with a deadline helper that older iOS supports
deprecate: Ending a recording on the first non-running audio state

architecture.reason: Changes only the existing capture and upload helpers.

auth.description: The browser keeps uploading after an access-token refresh only when subject, session identifier and issuer all match the token held at the start. Any other change stops the upload. Server verification of every token is unchanged.

egress.description: Same destinations and request bodies. Cancellation and the 60 second limit are preserved. With owner approval on November 27, the egress review source hash for voiceApi.ts was rebound; the reviewed wake-up call is unchanged.

cost.description: A segment that fails for a passing reason may be sent up to two more times on the existing free route, each with its own accounting reservation.

tests.scope: Upload works without AbortSignal.any and cancelled recordings send nothing.
Passing interruptions resume, lasting or closed ones end once, and a hung start releases the microphone.
Only passing failures retry, bounded; security, sign-in and quota results never do.
Another user, session, issuer, sign-out or unreadable token stops the upload.

rollout: Frontend only. Verify on a physical iPhone from the candidate build before promotion.
rollback: Re-promote the previous verified frontend build; no database changes.
knownGaps: Mixed English, Urdu and Hindi transcription is not repaired.
No physical iOS, Safari, real speech or real provider verification.

blockers: Physical iPhone microphone acceptance on the candidate build.
